questions.question: Two trains cross each other in 12 seconds when they travel in opposite directions and they take 60 seconds when they travel in the same direction. The possible speeds of the trains, (in m/sec), can be:
questions.solution:

Let the total length of the both train be d m

As we know,

Speed × Time = Distance

Condition First

(x + y) × 12 = D ---(1)

(x – y) × 60 = D ---(2) 

From equation (1) and equation (2)

(x + y) × 12 = (x – y) × 60

⇒ x + y = (x – y) × 5

⇒ x + y = 5x – 5y

⇒ 5x – x = 5y + y

⇒ 4x = 6y

So, the ratio of speed of two train is 3 : 2.

The monthly incomes of Abinav and Rekha are in the ratio 6 : 5 and their monthly 

expenditures are the ratio 9 : 8The monthly incomes of Abinav and Rekha are in

the ratio = 6x : 5x

**Calculation:**

The expenditure ratio of Abinav and Rekha are in the ratio = 9y : 8y

According to the question

6x = 2 × 8y

⇒ 6x = 16y

⇒ x : y = 8 : 3

Let x = 8 and y = 3

Savings of Abinav = 6x – 9y = 6 × 8 – 9 × 3 = 48 – 27 = 21

Savings of Rekha = 5x – 8y = 5 × 8 – 8 × 3 = 40 – 24 = 16

Profit percentage = (51.75/287.5) × 100 = 18%

questions.question: Pipes A and B can empty a full tank in 8 and 12 hours, respectively. C is a filling pipe. All the three pipes were opened together at the same time and one-sixth of the tank got emptied in one hour. C alone can fill the tank in:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Pipes A and B can empty a full tank in 8 and 12 hours, respectively.

C is a filling pipe.

All the three pipes were opened together at the same time and one-sixth of the tank got emptied in one hour.

**Formula:**

If a pipe empties a tank in 'a' hours and an another empties the same tank in 'b' hours then

Total work = LCM of the times taken by two different pipes = LCM of (a, b)

Efficiency of first pipe = (-) LCM of (a, b)/a

Efficiency of second pipe = (-) LCM of (a, b)/b

Time taken to fill the tank = Total work/The combined efficiency of the pipes.

Now, if another pipe fills the tank in 'c' hours, then

Combined efficiency of the three pipes = (- efficiency of pipe A) + (- efficiency of pipe B) + (+ efficiency of pipe C)

(-)ve sign is mentioned as they empty the tank and (+)ve sign is to imply that the pipe fills the tank.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/716db7cfaeda1353ddfb5f5d9a747cb22febeba60c0c3f5c1f3475bcc2842393.png] 

Here in the fig, LCM of (8, 12) = 24 = Total work 

Efficiency of A = 24/8 = 3

Efficiency of B = 24/12 = 2

(-)ve sign is mentioned as A and B empty the tank.

1/6th of total work = 24/6 = 4 = combined efficiency of three pipes

Let the efficiency of pipe C be x, then

⇒ x – 3 – 2 = – 4

⇒ x = 5 – 4

⇒ x = 1

**∴ the pipe C alone can fill the tank in = 24/1 = 24 hrs**

questions.question: The average of 21 numbers is 44. The average of the first 11 numbers is 48 and that of the last 11 numbers is 42. If the 11th number is excluded, what is the average of the remaining numbers?
questions.solution:
The average of 21 numbers = 44

Sum of 21 numbers = 44 × 21 = 924

The average of the first 11 numbers = 48

The sum of the first 11 numbers = 48 × 11 = 528

The average of the last 11 numbers = 42

The sum of the last 11 numbers = 42 × 11 = 462

11th number = 462 + 528 – 924 = 66

The sum of 20 numbers = 924 – 66 = 858

Average of 20 numbers = 858/20 = 42.9

questions.question: The marked price of an article is Rs.x. After allowing a discount of 20% on the marked price, a shopkeeper gains Rs. 40. If his profit is 11(1)/(9)\%then the value of x is:
questions.solution:
11(1)/(9)\% = (1)/(9)

MP of the article be Rs. x

SP of the article = x × (80/100) = 0.8x

Let the CP of the article be Rs. y, then

y × (10/9) = 0.8x

⇒ y = 0.8x × (9/10)

⇒ y = 0.72x

So, the CP of the article = Rs. 0.72x

According to the question

Profit = 0.8x – 0.72x

40 = 0.08x

⇒ x = 40/0.08

⇒ x = 500

So the Marked price of the article be Rs. 500.

**Short trick : **

11(1)/(9)\% = (1)/(9)

Let CP = 9 unit

SP = 9 × (10/9) = 10 unit

MP = 10 × (5/4) = 12.5 unit

⇒ [10 – 9 = 1 unit] = Rs. 40

⇒ 12.5 unit = 40 × 12.5 = Rs. 500

questions.question: A, B and C can do apiece of work in 36 days, 54 days and 108 days, respectively. They started the work together but a left 9 days after the start of the work and B left 3 days before the work was completed. For how many days did C work?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d55a4f7af62311d8c1435d1393d0aaf1c0fa00c67d7bbcc098c49225acce3d9d.png] 

Total work = 108

Let the work finish in x days,

According to the question

3 × 9 + (x – 3) × 2 + x = 108

⇒ 27 + 2x – 6 + x = 108

⇒ 21 + 3x = 108

⇒ 3x = 108 – 21 = 87

⇒ x = 87/3

⇒ x = 29

So, C did work for 29 days.

questions.question: The total surface area of a solid cylinder is 1155 cm². Its curved surface area is two-fifth of its total surface area. What is the height (in cm) of the cylinder?
questions.solution:
As we know,

Curved surface area of cylinder = 2 πrh

Total surface area of the cylinder = 2 πr (r + h)

According to the question

2πrh = (2/5) × 2πr (r + h)

⇒ 5h = 2r + 2h

⇒ 5h – 2h = 2r

⇒ 3h = 2r

Let r : h = 3x : 2x

Total surface area of the cylinder = 2 πr (r + h)

2 πr (r + h) = 1155

⇒ 2 × (22/7) × 3x (3x + 2x) = 1155

⇒ 2 × (22/7) × 3x × 5x = 1155

⇒ x² = (1155 × 7)/(2 × 22 × 3 × 5) = (7 × 7)/(2 × 2)

⇒ x = √[(7 × 7)/(2 × 2)]

⇒ x = 7/2

Height of the cylinder = 2 × (7/2) = 7 cm

**∴ The correct answer is 7 cm.**

questions.question: What 5,6,8,9 and 12 divide the least number x, the remainder each case is 1, but x is divisible by 13. What will be the remainder when x is divided by 31?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a23b2c315dd43903191e6409882df1eaf0a643815a605f3e2f11f67130860cd4.png] 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ab0d9ab7386d935c4af1dc3c893fa78b1352b19fb23ca47a960549ee2380b0f7.png] 

LCM of 5, 6, 8, 9 and 12 is 360.

If remainder in each case is 1 and the number divisible by 13, then

The number is (360x + 1) divisible by 13, so

(360x + 1)/13

⇒ 27x + (9x + 1)/13

(9x + 1) is divisible by 13 if we put x = 1, 2, 3, 4, ……..

Put x = 10, then

⇒ (9 × 10 + 1)

⇒ 91

As we know, 91 is divisible by 13 so put x = 10

360x + 1

⇒ 360 × 10 + 1

⇒ 3600 + 1

⇒ 3601

If 3601 is divisible by 31, the the remainder will be 5.

questions.question: Twice the speed of a is equal to thrice the speed of B. to travel a certain distance, A takes 42 minutes less than B to travel the same distance. What is the time (in minutes) taken by B to travel the same distance?
questions.solution:
According to the question

⇒ 2 × A = 3 × B

⇒ A : B = 3 : 2

The speed ratio of A to that of B = 3x : 2x

As we know, Time is inversely proportion to speed.

Time ratio of A to that of B = 2x : 3x

⇒ 3x – 2x = 42 min

⇒ x = 42 min

Time taken by B to complete the distance = 3 × 42 = 126 min

questions.question: The length of a rectangle is 6cm more than its breadth and its perimeter is 100 cm. If the area of the rectangle is very nearly equal to the area of a circle, then what is the circumference of the circle?(Take π = 22/7)
questions.solution:
Let the breadth of the rectangle be x cm

Length of the rectangle = (x + 6) cm

As we know,

Perimter of the rectangle = 2 (l + b)

2 (l + b) = 100

⇒ 2 (x + 6 + x) = 100

⇒ 2x + 6 = 100/2

⇒ 2x + 6 = 50

⇒ 2x = 50 – 6

⇒ 2x = 44

⇒ x = 44/2

⇒ x = 22

Breadth of the rectangle = 22 cm

questions.question: Out of 90 students in a class, 60% are girls and rest are boys. The average score in English of boys is 30% more than that of girls. If the average score in English of all the students is 56, then what is the same for the girls?
questions.solution:
Let the total students in the class be 5

Number of girls in the class = 5 × (3/5) = 3

Number of boys in the class = 5 – 3 = 2

Let the average score of girls be 10x

The average score of boys = 10x × (13/10) = 13x

According to the question

2 × 13x + 3 × 10x = 5 × 56

⇒ 26x + 30x = 280

⇒ 56x = 280

⇒ x = 280/56

⇒ x = 5

Average score of girls in English = 10 × 5 = 50
